team.bio: Bapiraju brings over 25 years of financial market expertise. As the principal leader of the firm, his insights govern the high-level retirement planning, long-term asset allocation frameworks for the clients. His extensive industry tenure and profound market insight elevate our mutual fund distribution company standards to the highest professional level.

team.title: Co-Founder & Managing Director
team.bio: Aparna is the Co-Founder and MD of Bhavya Sampada. An MBA in Finance with over 5 years of experience, she holds AMFI, PMS, and insurance advisory credentials. Her modern, forward-thinking perspective and multi-asset expertise enable her to relate to and effectively design financial strategies for a diverse, multi-generational client base.
